title: artemisia gallica subsp. gargantae
intro: Artemisia gallica subsp. gargantae, commonly known as French tarragon, is a subspecies of the wormwood plant. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and reduce stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Artemisia gallica subsp. gargantae include essential oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
